title: carthamus calvus
intro: Carthamus calvus, commonly known as Woolly Safflower or Safflower, is a flowering plant native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Carthamus calvus include its ability to act as an antidiarrheal, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it a potential treatment for various gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of Carthamus calvus include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
